events.title: Puck'n Hell Launches in 3 Days!
events.summary: Puck'n Hell Launches in 3 Days! The wait is almost over. Puck'n Hell launches on Steam on October 29! In just three days, the table is yours. Face five condemned souls in intense arcade air hockey battles, where every shot, bounce and mistake matters. No rubber-banding, no scripted wins. Just you, your opponent and the puck. events.title: Demo Hotfix — Head Tracking v0.1.7
events.summary: Fixes for the head tracking added in the last update. Mouse and gamepad play are unaffected.- The menu cursor no longer stutters or stalls — it moves smoothly now.- Fixed the cursor not moving at all for some players.- Smile detection now calibrates to your face, so clicking works more consistently.- Fixed the paddle lurching across the table at the start of a round.- Fixed the cursor stopping working after turning head tracking off and back on in Settings.

events.title: Demo Update — Hands-Free Menus v0.1.6
events.summary: - Steer the pointer with your head anywhere outside a match — main menu, settings, character select, pause, end of match.- Smile to click.- Reach for the mouse whenever you want and it takes over instantly.
